spirv_cross.role: build-time SPIR-V -> GLSL ES 3.00 translator (browser/WebGL 2 backend artifact)
spirv_cross.limitations: SPIRV-Cross rejects BaseVertex/BaseInstance in the ES profile. Author Slang vertex inputs with SV_VulkanVertexID / SV_VulkanInstanceID (not SV_VertexID) so the emitted SPIR-V uses plain VertexIndex/InstanceIndex (no SPV_KHR_shader_draw_parameters).
spirv_cross.build_manifest: Bootstrap writes <binary>.build.json with verified source identity and the host-built binary hash; the offline helper verifies both before executing.
